description: This file contains a minimal API client wrapper class for interacting with the OrangeHRM API, including authentication and request execution methods.

classes.name: OrangeHrmApiClient
classes.description: A sealed class providing methods to create authenticated API clients and perform authentication with the OrangeHRM API.

methods.name: CreateClient
methods.description: Creates and configures a RestSharp client with the stored cookie container and base URL.

methods.name: AuthenticateAsAdmin
methods.description: Performs authentication with admin credentials and updates the cookie container for subsequent requests.

methods.name: ExecuteAuthed
methods.description: Executes an authenticated request using the shared cookie container; caller must have authenticated first.
